trials.claim: The app blurs sensitive data on web instantly when recording or screen sharing
trials.claimQuote: Blur all your sensitive data on web instantly, when recording or screen sharing.
trials.reasoning: The vendor admits a browser extension cannot control some areas and points to a separate app, limiting the 'blur all' promise, and a buyer warns it does not safeguard sensitive data during live screen sharing.

exhibits.quote: No, that is not something a browser extension can control. Hence we made sperate app for this called blurscreen.app
exhibits.argument: The vendor admits the extension cannot blur the URL bar, so it does not blur all sensitive data on web instantly.

exhibits.quote: I strongly discourage using this app, especially if you expect it to provide security and privacy when sharing your screen live while safeguarding sensitive or crucial data.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the app fails to provide security and privacy when sharing screen live.

exhibits.quote: Blur your sensitive data instantly, when recording or screen sharing. No editing required
exhibits.argument: Vendor homepage states the same instant blur when recording or screen sharing benefit.

exhibits.quote: It's fast, simple, and highly effective for quickly blurring sensitive information without any hassle.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the app quickly and effectively blurs sensitive information as promised.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes single click to blur image, paragraph, or input field
trials.claimQuote: Single click to blur image, paragraph, or input field
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes single-click blurring of paragraphs, images and other web elements, and a buyer confirms point-and-click blurring works.

exhibits.quote: Blur any web elements with single click be it heading, paragraph, image or a video.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes single-click blur for paragraph, image and other elements.

exhibits.quote: I like that I can either use the point and click to identify elements to blur, or just drag a quick box.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms point-and-click to identify elements to blur works as described.
